criteria.text: Calculates the last date to serve non-renewal notice as 26 June 2027 (90 days before the 24 September 2027 expiry), and warns that otherwise the agreement renews for 2 years.
Identifies that the planned reorganisation may be a change of control deemed an assignment under Clause 19, requiring the counterparty's consent.

Identifies that data protection breaches are not carved out of the $500,000 liability cap in Clause 11, leaving the customer under-protected for data breach losses, and recommends a separate higher cap or carve-out.
Calculates the service credit as $10,000 (25% of the $40,000 monthly fee for 97.4% availability) and identifies that the supplier's offer of $2,000 is too low.
Shows the service credit arithmetic (25% x $40,000 = $10,000) and flags the discrepancy with $2,000.
Gives the notice window as 90 days and as the date 26 June 2027, with days remaining from 4 March 2027 (114 days).
Gives a pinpoint citation (document name and section/clause number) for every issue or finding.
